results.name: Initial idle lifetime is immediately fulfilled without rendering
One in-flight request owns its buffer, rejects overlap, then permits exact buffer reuse
Invalidation suppresses stale pixels but never releases shared readback memory early
Stale readback rejection is consumed without presenting an obsolete error
Focus, controller, arm, theme and visibility snapshot changes independently suppress presentation
A context predicate that invalidates reentrantly cannot accept its now-stale frame
Synchronous submission errors report once, settle idle, and allow recovery
Asynchronous submission rejection is consumed, reported once, and does not poison reuse
A synchronously throwing presentation reports once and releases pending ownership
Asynchronous presentation owns the pixel buffer until fulfilled or rejected
Throwing context validation is handled once for both fulfilled and rejected readbacks
Error-reporting exceptions, including a failed logger, cannot hang the queue
Reentrant requests cannot overlap and whenIdle is already valid inside render/present
Synchronous compatibility readback is presented asynchronously without copying its supplied bytes
A thenable with a throwing then accessor is consumed as a failed readback
All controlled failure paths leave zero unhandled Promise rejections

scope: Production queue with controlled read/present Promises, exact buffer identity, single in-flight ownership, stale generation/context rejection, error recovery and reentrant idle lifetime. No UI, pixel color, GPU latency, browser FPS or 72-pipe physical result is claimed.
review: App integration snapshots station/controller/arm/theme; invalidation protects reset/start/stop/task/focus/theme/hide changes. camera-feeds renderer-state/color contracts are separately covered by test-camera-feed-async-perf-v2.mjs and test-multi-camera-feeds.mjs.
